newsitem.title: USA: FIRST UNION SETS NEW REAL ESTATE LOAN PROGRAM.
newsitem.headline: FIRST UNION SETS NEW REAL ESTATE LOAN PROGRAM.

text.p: First Union Corp said Tuesday its capital markets group is launching a new program to source, underwrite and sell class "A" permanent commercial real estate loans.

The warehouse program will expand First Union's loan services to include underwriting of permanent, non-recourse real estate debt for shopping centers, apartments and other high quality commercial properties, the bankholding company said.

First Union currently provides short-term construction loans for Class "A" properties but places the permanent loans with insurance companies and other institutional investors. It said it will continue this practice alongside the new program.

The Class "A" program will offer various types of commercial mortgages, including immediate funding fixed rate permanent loans, forward fixed rate permanent loans and construction/permanent combination loans.
Typically, Class "A" property is newer real estate located in major metropolian areas.
The loans will be originated from First Union's East Coast franchise and through offices in Houston, Chicago and Irvine, Calif., it said.
